unit.why: This division gathers ethical-homiletic quotations (Shevet Musar, Midrash Rabbah, Agra de-Kallah) on a preacher avoiding pride and practising what he preaches, and it closes the section for the letter ד; there is no narrative.
unit.boundary_note: the closing words 'ונתחיל אות ה ... מענין הבטחה על מחר' introduce the next division's section
